description: Ministry of Plantation Industries - Order made under Section 13(1)(b) of Sri Lanka Tea Board Law, No. 14 of 1975
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that varies the cess (tax) imposed under the Sri Lanka Tea Board Law, No. 14 of 1975. It contains a statutory instrument issued by the Minister using powers vested by specific legislation, changing the tax rate from "rupees three hundred for every one hundred kilograms" to "rupees four hundred for every one hundred kilograms." While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the regulatory function rather than constituting a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is regulatory in nature, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory).
